facts.statement: Riabininohadros is an extinct genus of ankylopollexian dinosaur that lived during the Maastrichtian in Crimea.
facts.quote: Riabininohadros (meaning "Riabinin's hadrosaur") is an extinct genus of ankylopollexian dinosaur from the Maastrichtian of Crimea.

facts.statement: The type species of the genus is Riabininohadros weberae.
facts.quote: Its type species is Riabininohadros weberi, emended to Riabininohadros weberae.

facts.statement: The dinosaur was first described by Anatoly Nikolaevich Riabinin in 1945 based on hindlimb elements found in Crimea.
facts.quote: It was originally named Orthomerus weberi when first described by Anatoly Nikolaevich Riabinin in 1945 for hindlimb elements from an unnamed Maastrichtian-age formation in Crimea of what is now Ukraine.

facts.statement: The fossils were discovered in 1934 near Bakhchysarai by Gertruda Weber, whose name is included in the species epithet.
facts.quote: These were in 1934 near Bakhchysarai found by Gertruda Weber who is honoured in the specific name.

facts.statement: The discovery was reported in the scientific literature in 1937.
facts.quote: The find was in 1937 reported in the scientific literature.

facts.statement: In 2018, it was revealed that the original describer had misidentified several fossil elements.
facts.quote: In 2018, it transpired that Riabinin had misidentified several elements.

facts.statement: A juvenile skeleton excavated at Aleshino in 1965 was considered to belong to a different hadrosaurid species.
facts.quote: A postcranial juvenile skeleton in 1965 excavated at Aleshino, was considered to represent a different species, a hadrosaurid.

facts.statement: Although considered a nomen dubium, the dinosaur was informally assigned to the genus Riabininohadros by Roman Ulansky.
facts.quote: Although tossed as a nomen dubium in recent reviews of Hadrosauridae, it was informally given its own genus "Riabininohadros" by Russian amateur paleontologist Roman Ulansky.

facts.statement: The name Riabininohadros became valid only after Lopatin and Averianov formally published it in 2020.
facts.quote: As this publication did not meet the requirements of the International Code of Zoological Nomenclature, "Riabininohadros" was not a valid name for the taxon until the name was formally published as new by Lopatin and Averianov in 2020.

facts.statement: Lopatin and Averianov classified Riabininohadros as a primitive member of the Ankylopollexia, specifically the Styracosterna, based on its basal astragalus.
facts.quote: Instead, Lopatin and Averianov, in view of its basal astragalus, classified Riabininohadros as a primitive member of the Ankylopollexia, more specially the Styracosterna, well outside Hadrosauroidea, with uncertain relationships to other taxa in the clade.

facts.statement: Riabininohadros weberae lived during the Late Cretaceous, approximately 72 to 66 million years ago, in what is now Europe.
facts.quote: Riabininohadros weberae es la única especie del género Riabininohadros de dinosaurio ornitópodo hadrosáurido que vivió a finales del período Cretácico, hace aproximadamente entre 72 66 millones de años en el Maastrichtiense, en lo que hoy es Europa.

facts.statement: The fossil record for Riabininohadros spans from 72.2 to 66 million years ago during the Maastrichtian.
facts.quote: Time range: Maastrichtian to Maastrichtian (72.2 to 66 million years ago)

facts.statement: Riabininohadros is classified within the infraorder Iguanodontia.
Riabininohadros belongs to the unranked family Ankylopollexia.
